test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

A story has been written by Sarath.

options.text: Sarath was written by a story.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The type of the sentence is declarative, and the tense of the given sentence is present perfect.
 
• The subject of the given sentence** (in passive voice)** is **"A story" **and the agent (or the doer of the action) is **"Sarath.**"
 
• **Passive Format:**
 
 
• **Subject + has/have + been + V3 + by + Object . **
 
• **For example,** "A letter has been written by her."
 
 
 
• **Active Format: **
 
 
• **Subject (Objective case) + has/have + V3 (past participle form of the verb) + Object (Subjective case). **
 
• **For example,** "She has written a letter."
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is- *“Sarath has written a story.”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 ("Sarath was written by a story.") **inverts the relationship between the subject and the object incorrectly, suggesting the story wrote Sarath.
 
• **Option 2 ("Sarath wrote a story.")** is in the simple past tense, not the present perfect tense.
 
• **Option 3 ("Sarath have written a story.") **is grammatically incorrect due to the use of "have" instead of "has," given that "Sarath" is a singular subject
